description: React class component 'EditableBlock' for a rich text editing block with drag-and-drop, tag selection, image upload, and context menus.

classes.name: EditableBlock
classes.description: A React component representing an editable content block with rich text, image, and drag-and-drop features.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initializes placeholder or loads content when component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Sends updates to parent when content, tag, or image changes.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Updates HTML content state on content change.

methods.name: handleBlur
methods.description: Adds placeholder if content is empty on blur.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events for commands, backspace, and enter.

methods.name: handleKeyUp
methods.description: Opens tag selector menu on '/' key.

methods.name: handleMouseUp
methods.description: Opens action menu on text selection.

methods.name: handleDragHandleClick
methods.description: Opens action menu on drag handle click.

methods.name: openActionMenu
methods.description: Displays action menu at calculated position.

methods.name: handleTagSelection
methods.description: Handles tag selection, including image insertion.

methods.name: handleImageUpload
methods.description: Uploads image and updates state with image URL.

methods.name: addPlaceholder
methods.description: Adds placeholder text for empty first block.

methods.name: calculateActionMenuPosition
methods.description: Calculates position for action menu based on trigger.

methods.name: calculateTagSelectorMenuPosition
methods.description: Calculates position for tag selector menu.
